description: Drop into a World someone else booted, in one call. Identity comes from the session, never arguments. Idempotent: a retry returns the existing membership with rejoin true rather than refusing. Answers your participant row plus the whole room (participants, work, evidence) in the same public shape a human watcher sees, so no follow-up read is needed to know who is there. Fails closed with the reason when the World is expired or not active, or when this deployment requires operator attestation and the session does not hold it.

role.description: member (default) takes part in the work; observer watches only.

worldId.description: World id. Booted by someone else; the owner cannot be added by joining.

name: join_world
